Other announcements remained plans or approvals without public spending records.
packages.evidence_cutoff_note: The window starts strictly after September 30 at 12:21:42 p.m. ET with inclusive replay of date-only September 30 sources. The focused monitor selected 56 routes across 55 URLs, reached 53 and was blocked on three SEC routes; Federal Register/Public Inspection and exact issuer records supplied alternate custody. General tax, sanctions and statistical work was excluded unless it changed a covered institution's authority, finance, market or operating state.
packages.use_note: Use as the bounded September 30 boundary-to-October 2 receipt. Follow detailed DTC and Fed claims to the fed-clearing-treasury owner, and preserve adoption, publication, effectiveness, implementation, operation, payment and observed effect as separate clocks.

packages.title: The four Trump indictments were four different legal stories
packages.question: What did the four criminal indictments against Donald J. Trump actually charge, how did the count structures differ, what later rulings changed them, and what was the procedural state of each case by October 1, 2026?
packages.bluf: The famous 91-count total was a real peak snapshot, but only New York reached a verdict; the other three cases ended before a jury resolved the allegations.
packages.evidence_cutoff_note: The four charging instruments, New York jury instructions and verdict, the Florida appointment dismissal, Supreme Court immunity and obstruction opinions, the federal election dismissal motion, Georgia quashal orders and the replacement prosecutor's nolle memorandum were reviewed. New York appellate orders through May 19, 2026 were checked; no merits appellate decision was located. Official DOJ summaries of 2025 FOIA rulings concerning Volume II were also checked. Some filed objects are preserved from public docket mirrors where PACER or a court download path prevented direct retrieval; the source ledger records custody and claim limits.
packages.use_note: Use for the criminal charging and disposition record only. Do not combine civil judgments, impeachments or investigations that produced no indictment. Preserve the difference between allegations, adjudicated conviction, pretrial legal dismissal, prosecutor nolle and appellate finality.

packages.title: Capital letters do not create a second United States
packages.question: Does changing the capitalization of United States of America create a different legal entity, especially on a U.S. passport?
packages.bluf: The passport's authority comes from federal law and State Department issuance, not the capitalization on its cover.
packages.evidence_cutoff_note: Focused official-source review of the 2026 commemorative passport page, passport-issuance statute, National Archives Articles transcript, GPO production role, ICAO machine-readable-document standard, October 1 Tenth Circuit opinion, 28 U.S.C. § 3002 and the 1871 District of Columbia Organic Act. This is not a complete census of passport designs or all capitalization cases.
packages.use_note: Use to resolve capitalization and passport-cover claims. Preserve genuine actor, capacity and statutory-definition distinctions, but do not infer a second legal person from typography, abbreviations or machine-readable formatting.

packages.title: How the United States is wired into the international order
packages.question: How do the major international organizations, treaty regimes, forums and parallel accords involving the United States actually work, and where can membership, money, standards, infrastructure or operating functions migrate without formal institutional replacement?
packages.bluf: The international order is changing one job at a time. Countries are leaving some bodies, rebuilding others and creating smaller groups for specific tasks; they are not replacing the whole system at once.
packages.evidence_cutoff_note: All seven waves are reconciled through October 4, 2026. The October 5 Artemis principals meeting, PP-26, UNESCO's December 31 exit and UNFCCC's February 27, 2027 exit remained future. Forum direction, institutional decision, domestic implementation, funding, operation and outcome remain separate clocks.
packages.use_note: The final reconciliation and 27-object registry control. Treat exit, defunding, parallel doctrine, shared machinery, resource migration and default use as separate states. Do not flatten the World Bank Group, treat a G7/G20 statement as an institutional act, treat a BIS-hosted or ITU technical standard as U.S. law, collapse IMO or WIPO membership into separately administered treaties, treat CERN observer status as membership, describe ITER requests as deliveries, or treat Board appointments, pledges and pre-deployment work as completed Gaza field governance.
